answer: Collateral is locked before dawn, the moment the round's words are revealed: a copper tier bond is 20 POA, a jade tier bond 50 POA, and late deposits are refused, so a forger cannot fund only the fakes that end up graded. 1,000 copper sybils freeze 20,000 POA every round, and fakes caught giving matching answers forfeit the whole bond. Colluders cannot pool one deposit, as each bond binds to a single address. An honest agent locks one bond and gets it back.
